name: Tateishi Souji
source:
The protagonist. Souji is serious, but not too serious and has mediocre grades. After returning with his younger sister [url=/c55364]Mayuri[/url] to the town they used to live in, he reunites with [url=/c40162]Kanade[/url].

Fairly kind and fairly blockheaded, he's often in denial when it comes to feelings from women, going "I'm overthinking it, there's no way she loves me".

He's classmates with Kanade and [url=/c40164]Saki[/url]. Childhood friends with Kanade and [url=/c40163]Hayane[/url], and Hayane is also his first love.
Although he was acquainted with [url=/c40165]Yuiri[/url] whom his little sister often brought in, he didn't know she was Saki's little sister.
